name: 3 Teir Compase
shortDescription: A three-part stained-glass window built around a large blue-and-black compass, a smaller clover, and a red-and-blue rose heart.
description: This stained-glass window is composed of three progressively smaller sections and takes its name from the compass at the top. The top section is a blue-and-black compass roughly two to three feet in diameter.

The middle section is intentionally a fraction of the compass size and can be viewed as either a ten-leaf or five-leaf clover. The bottom section is a red-and-blue rose heart, smaller again and roughly half the size of the compass.
The changing scale ties the three symbols together while keeping the compass as the dominant feature of the full window.
